recipe.title: Kiwi & Unsalted Mixed Seed Snack Pots
recipe.description: A simple portable snack of ripe kiwi with a crunchy unsalted mixed-seed topping, packed separately until eating so the seeds stay crisp and the fruit remains fresh.

ingredients.purchase_notes: Choose ripe but still firm fruit without bruised or leaking areas.
ingredients.notes: Use 1 medium kiwi per serving. Whole fruit does not scale perfectly for every serving quantity; round sensibly when scaling.

ingredients.purchase_notes: Use 50 g in total. Choose an unsalted mixed-seed blend; exact seed proportions and pack size may vary.
ingredients.notes: A blend containing pumpkin, sunflower and sesame seeds provides useful flavour and texture. Check the package allergen declaration.

equipment.notes: Used to portion the mixed seeds.
Use separate dry compartments or small additional containers for the seeds.

mise_en_place.instruction: Peel the 2 kiwi fruit, trim away the hard stem ends, then cut the flesh into bite-sized pieces approximately 15-20 mm across.
mise_en_place.endpoint: The kiwi pieces are evenly sized, intact and not excessively crushed or watery.
The seeds are accurately measured and remain completely dry.

procedure.title: Portion the kiwi
procedure.instruction: Divide the prepared kiwi evenly between the two snack pots, giving approximately 1 kiwi per serving. Keep any released fruit juice with the kiwi rather than allowing it into the dry seed compartment.
procedure.endpoint: Each pot contains an even portion of fresh kiwi with no fruit or juice entering the dry seed compartment.

corrective_actions.condition: The kiwi releases a large amount of juice during cutting.
corrective_actions.action: Transfer the fruit with a slotted spoon or leave excess juice on the chopping board so the snack pot does not become unnecessarily wet.

procedure.title: Pack the mixed seeds
procedure.instruction: Divide the 50 g mixed seeds evenly between the two dry compartments or separate small containers, giving approximately 25 g per serving. Seal both portions so the seeds remain isolated from the kiwi until eating.
procedure.endpoint: Each serving contains approximately 25 g completely dry mixed seeds stored separately from the fruit.

corrective_actions.condition: The snack pots do not have separate dry compartments.
corrective_actions.action: Carry the seeds in two separate small reusable containers and add them immediately before eating.

plating.instruction: Immediately before eating, scatter the mixed seeds over the kiwi or eat them alongside it. Add the seeds only at the last moment so their crunch contrasts with the juicy fruit.

storage.storage_instructions: Refrigerate the cut kiwi promptly and use within 24 hours for the best texture. Keep the mixed seeds completely dry and separate until eating. For transport to work or on a car journey, carry the kiwi in an insulated bag with an ice pack and keep chilled until required.

either_retailer: Unsalted mixed seeds — 1 pack; use 50 g.

restaurant_quality_features: Ripe kiwi provides bright sweet-acid freshness without requiring added sweetener.
A mixed-seed blend supplies contrasting pumpkin, sunflower and sesame textures.
Separate packing preserves the seeds' crispness until eating.
The deliberately minimal ingredient list keeps the snack practical without adding components that provide little additional value.
nutrition_notes: Morning snacks have no minimum protein requirement.
Kiwi contributes fruit, vitamin C and fibre.
Mixed seeds contribute unsaturated fats, plant protein, fibre and minerals.
Nutrition values are estimates and will vary with kiwi size and the exact composition of the mixed-seed blend.
critical_success_factors: Use ripe but structurally firm kiwi so the prepared fruit remains in distinct pieces.
Keep fruit juice completely away from the mixed seeds during storage.
Keep the kiwi chilled during storage and transport.
Add the seeds only immediately before eating for maximum crunch.
